reMarkable Viewport for PaperDesk

This optional Krita Python plugin serves the current canvas to PaperDesk's explicitly started art session. Enable it in Krita's Python Plugin Manager and restart Krita after saving your artwork.

The plugin retains the tablet palette, eraser sizes, layer opacity, reference image docker and reference rotation controls. PaperDesk starts the sensor and tablet display session separately. Tablet display currently requires the supported Linux setup and the firmware-pinned Paper Pro extension.

Copying the plugin never installs a tablet extension or changes permissions. The local server uses a user-only socket. Existing plugins are preserved unless you explicitly request replacement with a backup.
